messages:
emma-cs: Hey team — customer AcmeMaps on Dedicated Gold reporting sudden 429s and big tail latency (~2s per request) starting ~0930 UTC. They say this started right after our morning deploy. They supplied a few request IDs and a sample header.

devon-sre: Thanks, can you paste the exact request headers and pool id they were routed to? Any logs from the control plane side?

emma-cs: Pasting what customer gave: 

x-redwood-tenant: acme-maps
x-redwood-tier: ["gold"]
model: text-infer-1
request-id: req_0a1b2c3d

Customer saw: 429 throttle, and in app logs: 
"""
2026-03-10T09:31:12Z request=req_0a1b2c3d selected_pool=small-shared-17 reason=rate_limit_exceeded
2026-03-10T09:31:12Z proxy_latency_ms=2100 endpoint=/v1/generate
"""

sam-platform: Whoa — tier header is coming in as a JSON array string. Our routing code expects comma-separated or single token, not a JSON array. Could be falling through to default selector. @devon-sre any recent route-parser changes? :eyes:

devon-sre: I pushed a small change last week to make header parsing stricter (GH#4420). It was meant to tighten CSV parsing but I didn't add an explicit JSON-array branch. Let me check logs for fallback behavior.

armaan-ml: Reproducer I just tried locally: curl with header `-H 'x-redwood-tier: ["gold"]'` causes selector to treat tier as literal string "[\"gold\"]" which doesn't match our tier map; fallback selects small-shared pool. Quick repro: 

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "x-redwood-tenant: acme-maps" \
  -H "x-redwood-tier: [\"gold\"]" \
  -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
```

Log shows `selected_pool=small-shared-17` immediately. If header is `-H 'x-redwood-tier: gold'` it picks `dedicated-gold-3` as expected.

emma-cs: Customer uses an API gateway that serializes headers as arrays. They only started sending arrays after a gateway update this morning. So mismatch is plausible.

devon-sre: OK confirming: routing parse path treats header values with `[` as non-matching token and falls back. That's our regression from the stricter CSV parsing change.

sam-platform: Impact: any customer sending tier header as JSON array gets mapped to default shared pool and will be subject to tenant-level shared throttles. That explains the 429s. Looks like multiple customers could be affected if their proxies send array headers. 

armaan-ml: Proposed mitigations: 1) Immediate: add a short-term control-plane rule to map literal header values matching `/^\["?(.*)"?\]$/` to the inner token (i.e., normalize arrays to first element). 2) Hotfix in routing parser to accept JSON arrays and CSV both. 3) Postmortem + add unit tests.

devon-sre: I can push the control-plane rule now (no deploy). I'll create INC-2026-543 and apply a mapping rule for tenants flagged by CS.

emma-cs: Please prioritize AcmeMaps — they're on Dedicated Gold and hitting production errors. I'll tell them we have a mitigation and to expect a fix soon.

deploy-bot: deploy job started for control-plane-rule-apply (no infra change) by devon-sre at 09:45 UTC.

deploy-bot: deploy finished successfully at 09:47 UTC. rule=normalize-tier-array target=control-plane-routing

devon-sre: Rule applied. @emma-cs can you confirm with AcmeMaps if new requests route to dedicated pool?

emma-cs: Pinged them. They responded: "verified — requests now go to dedicated-gold-3 and 429s stopped". :thumbsup:

armaan-ml: I'll open PR for parser hotfix and include tests for these header shapes (GH#4672). Plan: release hotfix to control plane routing service tomorrow 01:00 UTC with rollback flag.

sam-platform: Add integration test to catch gateways that emit JSON-array headers in our CI harness. Also add telemetry alert for sudden pool affinity shifts per-tenant.

devon-sre: Notes for post-incident: root cause = CSV parsing change didn't account for JSON-array header serialization. Remediation = control-plane normalization + parser hotfix. Ticket INC-2026-543, PR GH#4672.

emma-cs: Closing loop with customer, they asked for a note in their ticket that this was a routing-side bug and fix is applied. I'll attach the incident IDs.

armaan-ml: Postmortem checklist: timeline, customer impact, code diff, tests added, rollout windows. I'll start draft.

sam-platform: Great job catching this quickly. :party-parrot:

emma-cs: Thanks everyone — will update if AcmeMaps sees any regressions.
